provider: Google Identity Services directly; no managed third-party authentication provider
frontend_lint: passed with zero warnings and errors
backend_authentication_checks: Google signature verification using locally generated fixture signing keys
reject forged signature, wrong audience, issuer, expired token, nonce, and unverified identity
require authentication on all study and AI/STT endpoints
require CSRF on sign-in, sign-out, and study mutations
rotate application cookie, CSRF, and nonce on sign-in
revocable opaque login sessions, including old-cookie replay after logout
identity ownership uses verified Google subject instead of email or browser claims
expire sessions and restore still-live material after signing in again
safe Google outage and unconfigured-provider errors without a guest bypass
HttpOnly, SameSite, and production Secure cookie flags
reject malformed or oversized credential requests
browser_checks: Google-only sign-in gate, invalid-token error, and provider-script failure
authenticated upload, reload restoration, question, and answer requests
CSRF enforcement using the actual Flask middleware
sign-out removes workspace, revokes access, and releases microphone capture
different Google identity cannot access the prior student's source
keyboard focus and no horizontal viewport overflow
verification_boundary: Browser checks use an isolated Flask fixture with locally signed identity tokens, a stub Google SDK/certificate response, and simulated AI/STT. They do not validate a live Google account sign-in or production OAuth configuration.
database: not added; login sessions and study data are temporary server-memory state
